subject: HealthInsight: request for sampling & secure-erase certification
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@healthinsight.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Request: sampling evidence + secure-erase attestation for tenant logs

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. As part of our procurement review I'd like to confirm a couple of items before we move to final approval: 

1) For customer-specific retention deviations (we requested a 180-day session log TTL for our tenant) we need a small-scope sample that shows the deletion workflow and metadata (timestamps, job id, operator id). Can you provide a downloadable sample of deleted items (redacted) or a pointer to a secure bucket?

2) HealthLegal also requested a signed secure-erase certificate for tenant-scoped logs. The CAIQ/SIG reviewers expect an attestation that the deletion process is reproducible and auditable (ideally with a runnable job id and S3/GCS object ids).

We can accept redacted/sampled material for confidentiality. If there are any workarounds (e.g., signed statement + one redacted sample + AWS lifecycle record) that would speed review, please let me know.

Target: we'd like this by end of week (Fri 11/26) to keep our procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Nora
Nora Patel
Senior Security Analyst, HealthInsight

---
Attachment: HealthInsight_EvidenceChecklist.pdf (pdf, 45KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: sampling evidence + secure-erase attestation for tenant logs

Hi Nora —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Quick summary of what we can provide by Fri 11/26: 
- A signed secure-erase attestation (PDF) from our Security team describing the deletion workflow, operator controls, and hash checks.
- A redacted sample of deleted log metadata (JSON lines) that includes job id, deletion timestamp, and object reference (bucket:key) with sensitive tokens removed.
- Execution audit: a trace of the deletion job in our audit logs (redacted), showing the sequence and triggered lifecycle hooks.

Markus and Jordan, can you confirm we can produce these artifacts for the HealthInsight tenant (deal HI-7521) and whether we need Legal to sign-off on any export before sending?

Nora — we will upload the artifacts to a shared Drive folder and provide a short checklist. If HealthLegal needs DocuSign on the attestation, let us know and we can route it.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Note: we will not include raw PII. All samples are sanitized per our data handling policy.

Thanks — we downloaded the artifacts and reviewed the sample slice. A couple of quick asks before we close the procurement packet:

1) Can you add an explicit statement in the attestation about cryptographic hash validation (we want to see that object-level hash comparisons are part of the erase verification).
2) For the audit trace, please include the KMS key id that was used to rotate the deletion job logs (redacted key material is fine; we only need the KMS identifier).

If you can provide an updated attestation PDF with those two points and one additional redacted line in the sample showing the hash comparison result, we can sign-off. DocuSign is preferred for the attestation — please send a routing request to legal@healthinsight.com when ready.

Regards,
HealthInsight Legal
legal@healthinsight.com
